chunks: Al-Shaykh informed me from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Maḥbūb, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sinān, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام about a woman who sees that a man has intercourse with her in sleep in her private part until she emits fluid. He said: “She performs ghusl.”

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman being asked about in the ruling

ai.seo_question: Does a woman have to perform ghusl after a sexual dream if she emits fluid?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman who experiences a sexual dream and emits fluid. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that ghusl is required in this case, indicating the ruling of janabah resulting from such an experience.
